description: How often each start slot (P1 to P10, P11 or lower, pit lane) has won and reached the podium in Grand Prix races: over every circuit, or at one circuit, and optionally for one driver. Also the pole-to-win rate, the furthest-back winners and every win from P11 or lower ("has Hamilton won from P11 or lower?"). Sprints are not included.

circuit.description: Only this circuit (Kerbside circuit slug, e.g. "circuit-de-monaco"); omit for every circuit

driver.description: Only this driver's starts, wins and podiums (slug); omit for every driver

name: grid_wins
title: Wins and podiums by start slot
